offer:
Site Reliability Engineer

You will be on call for a payments platform built on GCP.

Requirements
- 4+ years operating Linux systems in production
- Kubernetes (GKE) is required
- Solid knowledge of networking: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing
- Familiarity with Datadog preferred
- Ideally, experience with Istio

Kubernetes certification (CKA) would be a plus. Knowledge of Spanish is optional.
